review_method: All 48 pages viewed in eight contact sheets; Chinese submission Word pages 4 and 5 additionally inspected at 1500-pixel page height

findings.finding: Q11 question heading and dataset name remain at the bottom of page 4; the preservation-summary answer starts on page 5. This separation is not present at that location in the review profile.
The Q15 introductory answer is on page 5, while the short budget table occupies only the top of page 6. This known short-budget tail-page weakness remains visible after reflow.
The Q5 question, policy and mapping-limit lead are on page 3; the two limitation bullets are on page 4. This new fixture exposes a pagination weakness despite preserved review content.

Q1 Shared arrangements heading and introductory line end page 2; the actual shared-policy paragraph begins page 3. The submission profile reflows this paragraph onto page 2; the underlying keep-with-next weakness is not fixed.

Existing fixed prose still has visible spaces before some Chinese sentence-final punctuation, including Q8 licensing and Q9 personal-data text. This pilot retains those prior translations; it is not a punctuation cleanup.

observations: No clipped or overlapping text was apparent in the reviewed overview images; this is not a general layout guarantee.
The English native PDFs retain two identical bounding-box intersections in wrapped cover/section titles. The visible glyphs are readable in both profiles; no new line-box intersection was introduced.
Removing notices changes page breaks even when every remaining sentence is preserved. Both profiles require separate layout regression cases.
All four native PDFs and all four LibreOffice previews remain six pages; unchanged page counts do not establish acceptable pagination.
